desc.zh: 白石城墙与双塔东门：尖拱门洞、扶壁、四角小尖塔，门外是通向广场的东门大道。
desc.en: A white-stone wall and twin-tower east gate with pointed arches, buttresses and corner pinnacles; the avenue leads in to the plaza.

desc.zh: 广场以南的街区：鼓座上的巴洛克穹顶（铜绿与白石），金色灯亭与小穹顶。
desc.en: The quarter south of the plaza: Baroque domes on drums in verdigris copper and white stone, with gilded lanterns and small corner domes.

desc.zh: 悬浮圣山正下方的圆形广场：同心铺石环、一圈黑白交替的无面容长袍立像、东门大道两侧的神像回廊。
desc.en: The round plaza beneath the floating mountain: concentric paving rings, a ring of alternating black and white faceless robed statues and a statue gallery along the east avenue.

desc.zh: 广场以北的街区：白石高屋、陡峭的深蓝板岩坡顶与细长的哥特式尖塔。
desc.en: The quarter north of the plaza: tall white-stone houses with steep slate roofs and slender Gothic spires.
